name: slr-assist
description: Systematic literature review assistant: Kitchenham & Charters (2007) for conducting, PRISMA 2020 for reporting. File-based tools without a server (slr.py, Python stdlib): project init, PRISMA-S search log, RIS/BibTeX/CSV/JSON import with DOI/title dedup, staged screening with protocol exclusion codes and researcher sign-off, quality appraisal, extraction, PRISMA flow counts + Mermaid diagram, BibTeX/RIS export. 1 skill, 1 slash command (/slr).
